about.registryInfo: First tokenized fund of Fidelity International (FIL Ltd), launched 13 May 2026 with Sygnum tokenization infrastructure and Chainlink NAV publication; rated Aaa-mf by Moody's; strategy mirrors FIL's ~$7B Irish-domiciled USD LVNAV liquidity fund (high-quality government securities + ABCP). Two share classes: FILQ-A (accumulating) and FILQ-D (distributing), both 2 decimals.
